verses: Kiya hum ney tera seena nahi khol diya
Aur tujh per say tera bojh hum ney utaar diya
Jiss ney teri peeth tor di thi
Aur hum tera zikar buland ker diya
Pus yaqeenan mushkil kay sath aasani hai
Be-shak mushkil kay sath aasani hai
Pus jab to farigh ho to ibadat mein mehnat ker
Aur apney perwerdigar hi ki taraf dil laga
